name: identical_complete_terms
label: equivalent
left_rules: Winner is based on the official league result. Overtime is included. Postponements within two days count. If the game is cancelled, the market resolves void. If there is a tie, the market resolves void. A shortened official game counts. If the game is abandoned, the market resolves void.
right_rules: Winner is based on the official league result. Overtime is included. Postponements within two days count. If the game is cancelled, the market resolves void. If there is a tie, the market resolves void. A shortened official game counts. If the game is abandoned, the market resolves void.

name: explicit_cancellation_conflict
label: different
left_rules: If the game is cancelled, the market resolves 50-50.
right_rules: If the game is cancelled, the market resolves Yes.

name: semantic_abandoned_conflict
label: different
left_rules: An abandoned game remains open until it is resumed and completed.
right_rules: An abandoned game is void and all positions are refunded.

name: semantic_shortened_game_conflict
label: different
left_rules: A result declared final after five innings determines the winner.
right_rules: All nine innings must be played; otherwise every position is refunded.

name: semantic_stat_correction_conflict
label: different
left_rules: Later official league corrections change the settled winner.
right_rules: The final-whistle result is used and later statistical corrections are ignored.

name: semantic_draw_payout_conflict
label: different
left_rules: A drawn game splits the payout equally between both team outcomes.
right_rules: A drawn game refunds each buyer's original purchase price.

name: complete_equivalent_paraphrase
label: equivalent
left_rules: Use the official league final including overtime. Postponed games stay open until completed. Cancellation or tie pays 50-50. A shortened official result counts, and an abandoned game waits for completion.
right_rules: The governing league's final winner after overtime controls. Delays do not close the market; it waits until play finishes. Cancelled and drawn games split equally. Official shortened games count; abandoned games remain pending until finished.
